architecture.snap: Observer-driven one-phase GSAP document-scroll glide; ScrollTrigger maps resulting scroll to normalized progress

media.sequence_cache: bounded decoded-frame LRU with priority preloading/backoff
media.scroll_linked_reverse_switch: pre-seek alternate encode and atomically swap after drawable seek

content_choreography.primary_engine: GSAP timeline synchronized with media playhead

mobile_viewport_guidance.ownership: host-site CSS, not core package CSS

sequence_fast_scroll.prediction: projects target progress ahead of aggressive swipes
sequence_fast_scroll.adaptive_frames: step 1/2/3/4 by velocity; endpoints remain exact
sequence_fast_scroll.queue: promotes current/predictive frames and prunes stale queued work
sequence_fast_scroll.preemption: at extreme velocity, may abort one stale low-priority active request
sequence_fast_scroll.settle: returns to exact frame selection after scrolling stops

snap_glide.input: ScrollTrigger.observe() wheel/touch intent at eligible boundaries
snap_glide.motion: one GSAP tween of real document scroll position
snap_glide.css_snap: suppressed during glide ownership and restored on destroy
snap_glide.tall_sections: native scrolling until outgoing final-viewport boundary
